_comment: Artifact packaging / grounding furniture — the shared sci-fi-hangar prop family that gives an artifact its relation to the ground (podium, step-base, wall-backing, framed readout). Parameterized by DNA; an artifact configures the right packaging from its spatial_needs. See blog: the artifact's close environment.

hangar_podium.name: Hangar Podium
hangar_podium.description: A battered, paneled sci-fi maintenance-bay plinth that an artifact stands ON so the player can reach it. Origin at the floor; the top is a work surface at a chosen reach height (top_height). Tray / flat / grate tops, clean / paneled / greebled sides, optional corner posts and an emissive rim light.

parameters.top_height: Top work-surface height in metres — the reach decision (default 1.0; 0.55 = low display, 0.9+ = console).
parameters.top_size: XZ size of the top surface, square (default 0.6).
parameters.taper: How much wider the base is than the top per side — battered plinth (default 0.12).
parameters.top_style: flat | tray | grate (default tray — recessed lip holds the artifact).
parameters.corner_posts: Four vertical corner posts framing the body (default false).
parameters.edge_light: Emissive accent strip under the top rim (default true).

artifact_readout_screen.name: Artifact Readout Screen
artifact_readout_screen.description: A curated, framed 2D-in-3D screen that names an artifact — a worn-metal bezel around a self-lit panel of baked text (amber header + green lines), on a stalk / wall-plate / two legs / desk stand. The deliberate replacement for floating billboard labels. Text is baked via BakedTextAlbedo (headless-safe).

hangar_step_base.name: Hangar Step Base
hangar_step_base.description: A low WIDE section of maintenance-bay floor the player steps ONTO to reach a big artifact or stand inside one. A thick slab rises one step (<=0.35m) with an inset paneled skirt, solid or grated top, a caution-striped front edge, a stencilled ID, an optional front ramp and optional back/side railing.

parameters.edge_rail: Low railing on back + two sides.
parameters.ramp: Sloped front ramp instead of a step face.
parameters.hazard_edge: Caution stripe along the front edge.
parameters.stencil_text: Stencilled ID on the front skirt.

hangar_wall_panel.name: Hangar Wall Panel
hangar_wall_panel.description: A modular maintenance-bay backing WALL behind an artifact — painted-metal plates with a perforated, greebled, or ribbed face, optional lit vertical seams, an embedded framed readout, a printed brand patch, a floor caution stripe and a stencilled ID.

parameters.brand_text: Brand patch near the top (empty = none).

hangar_cabinet_cluster.name: Hangar Cabinet Cluster
hangar_cabinet_cluster.description: A bank of mixed-height utility/server cabinets side by side — painted-metal boxes with inset panels, slatted vents, small self-lit status screens and stencilled unit IDs (U1..Un). unit_count sets how much wall the bank claims.

parameters.with_screens: Some units get a status readout.

hangar_supply_pile.name: Hangar Supply Pile
hangar_supply_pile.description: A staged pile of supplies — stacked crates (varying sizes, base crates bigger) with FRAGILE/KEEP DRY stencils, a red gas cylinder with a draping hose, and a striped warning cone. The lived-in clutter that furnishes a bay by its leftovers.

parameters.hazard_labels: FRAGILE/KEEP DRY stencils on crate faces.

hangar_barrier_fence.name: Hangar Barrier Fence
hangar_barrier_fence.description: A branded modular crowd/area barrier — pale-grey panels strung between dark posts on foot plates, a horizontal seam across each panel, a lab brand patch spanning the run. Bends into an L; optional caution stripe at the base.

parameters.brand_text: Brand patch across the run (empty = none).
parameters.subtitle_text: Smaller stencil line under the brand.
parameters.corner: Bend the run into an L.

hangar_worktable.name: Hangar Worktable
hangar_worktable.description: A battered painted-metal maintenance worktable — a flat top on four sturdy legs that turns a patch of floor into a workspace. Solid or grate top, optional drawer unit, fixed tool clutter, and a small back-standing DIAG readout.
